constraint.sentence: The back-pressure cap (max_open_agent_prs) accounted for 44.1% of fleet node-time between 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z and 2026-09-08T00:00:00Z; raise max_open_agent_prs, or climb a rung of the autonomy ladder in D18 (up to 800000s recoverable this window, an upper bound).
